Fixtures are synthetic, never labeled observed outcomes. The OEWS workbook contains literal hand-assigned employment/wage/suppression operands; it is not a downloaded BLS vintage. CPS tests hand-build fixed-width records from independently listed dictionary offsets and assert known weights, counts, ages, hours and earnings. Real official Census dictionaries/concordance are pinned under ../../sources/raw. No unit test requires network or the temporary live CPS archive cache.
